_comment: Curated Foundry lifecycle facts, verified against Microsoft Learn on 2026-09-19 and re-checked 2026-10-16. This is the same watch list that lives in the talk's planning notes. Re-verify before each delivery -- a demo that tells the room stale facts about staleness is a bad look.

features.name: Prompt Flow
features.detail: Feature development ended 2026-04-20. Full retirement 2027-04-20. Survives only in the Foundry (classic) portal and is not recommended for new development.

features.name: Microsoft Agent Framework
features.detail: Generally available since 2026-04-03. The stated migration path from Prompt Flow.

features.name: Assistants API
features.detail: Replaced by the Responses API (Agents v2). Threads/Messages/Runs/Assistants became Conversations/Items/Responses/Agent Versions.

features.name: Observability
features.detail: Evaluations, monitoring, and tracing went generally available in March 2026.

features.name: Client-side GenAI tracing
features.detail: Experimental preview. Spans and attributes may change. Requires AZURE_EXPERIMENTAL_ENABLE_GENAI_TRACING=true.

features.name: Instant access
features.detail: Call supported models by name with no deployment. Limited to the West US 3 region during preview.

features.name: Continuous evaluation
features.detail: Scores sampled live traffic and writes results alongside traces in Application Insights.

features.name: Agent optimizer
features.detail: Automatically generates improved instructions, skills, and tool descriptions for prompt and hosted agents.

features.name: A2A
features.detail: Agent-to-agent protocol. v1.0 is generally available; v0.3 remains in preview.

features.name: Toolbox
features.detail: Curate tools once and expose them behind a single managed MCP endpoint with centralized auth, governance, and versioning. Generally available for hosted agents; public preview for prompt agents since 2026-09-24.

features.name: Hosted agents
features.detail: Bring your own container or source zip on Agent Framework, LangGraph, the OpenAI Agents SDK, the Anthropic Agent SDK, or the GitHub Copilot SDK.

features.name: Managed compute
features.detail: Now in the new Foundry portal. Open-weight models from the curated Hugging Face collection on dedicated GPUs, billed per accelerator-hour, on the same endpoint and SDK as other deployments. No built-in content filtering in its data path during preview, and Global deployment only. Gated models and CPU deployments still need the Foundry (classic) portal.

features.name: Hugging Face models
features.detail: Curated, ungated Hugging Face models deploy from the new Foundry portal through managed compute (preview), with weights pre-staged in Azure. Gated models, and models not in the curated collection, still deploy through the Foundry (classic) portal.

features.name: Fine-tuning
features.detail: Model fine-tuning is generally available in Foundry projects in the new portal. OpenAI fine-tuning, Batch, and Stored completions work only in the resource's default project. Speech and Vision custom training still run through the Foundry (classic) portal.

features.name: Speech and Vision custom training
features.detail: Custom model training for Foundry Tools such as Speech and Vision is out of scope for the new portal and runs through the Foundry (classic) portal.
